plugins.name: feature-flow-lite
plugins.description: A capped subagent pipeline for features and fixes: Opus writes the acceptance criteria and orchestrates four Haiku roles (investigator, implementor, simplifier, reviewer).

plugins.name: figma-flow
plugins.description: Turn Figma frames into React that matches them: a skill that lints the frame, looks, then measures; a setup skill that prepares a repo for it; and a mod that saves Figma exports to disk and holds commits until the measurement passes.
